root_cause.summary: r3's eth1 interface toward r1 was configured in OSPF area 0.0.0.0 instead of area 0.0.0.1, an area-ID mismatch with r1's eth2 (area 0.0.0.1) and with r3's own other interfaces (eth2 to r2, eth3.10, eth3.20, loopback), all of which are area 0.0.0.1. This mismatch caused OSPF hellos on the r1-r3 transit link (10.0.13.0/30) to be rejected, so no adjacency formed and r3 lost its redundant uplink to r1, leaving it single-homed through r2.
